summary:
Last Signal is an interactive educational experience that brings the forgotten history of NASA's space exploration hardware to life. From lunar rovers and Apollo landing equipment left on the Moon to silent landers and rovers resting on Mars, Last Signal takes users on a journey across the solar system to discover the machines that made groundbreaking scientific discoveries possible.
Through interactive maps, immersive storytelling, mission timelines, and engaging educational activities, users can explore each artifact's purpose, mission, scientific achievements, and current operational status. Each machine has a story to tell, allowing users to connect with the technology, engineering, and discoveries behind humanity's exploration of space.
Designed especially for school-age students and curious space enthusiasts, Last Signal transforms scattered technical information into an engaging journey through humanity's achievements beyond Earth.
Their missions may have ended. Their signals may have faded. But their discoveries will echo forever.
